items.item: The common 'LLM adds 'static everywhere' failure mode works by accident: the bound was often forcing a clone/Arc/Box::leak to manufacture real 'static data, trading a compile error for a real allocation or leak rather than fixing the underlying design

Box::leak is the deliberate, rare case where minting a genuine &'static reference actually is the correct move, precisely because it is explicit about giving up the destructor rather than papering over a lifetime mismatch
